items.title: Robotics Operations Specialist
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. About the Role We're looking for a hands-on Robotics Operations Specialist to support teleoperation sessions, robot benchmarks, robotics data quality, and evaluation runs. You'll work closely with engineers and operators to ensure sessions run on time and on spec - troubleshooting hardware issues in real time, preparing evaluation environments, and helping improve operational processes. Responsibilities Teleoperations Support & Operator Relations - Provide hands-on support during teleoperation sessions: setup, monitoring, and real-time troubleshooting - Debug equipment issues (connectivity, hardware faults, peripheral failures) and escalate when needed - Manage session scheduling, collector onboarding, equipment handoff, and session-readiness checks - Travel to client sites and data collection locations to onboard and train operators on teleoperation systems, protocols, and best practices - Serve as the liaison between operators and hardware/data collection teams - systematically gathering feedback on equipment usability, workflow friction, and potential improvements - Synthesize actionable insights to inform hardware development and process decisions Benchmark & Evaluation Operations - Support execution of robot benchmarks and evaluations alongside research and engineering teams - Prepare robots, stations, props, and task environments according to defined protocols - Ensure consistent resets, trial conditions, and operator execution across runs - Investigate failed or inconsistent runs to identify whether issues stem from the model, robot hardware, environment setup, or operator execution Data Quality & Annotation - Review collected datasets to assess quality, flag inconsistencies, and ensure data meets training standards - Onboard annotators on robotics annotations to assess video quality - Perform data analysis to identify patterns in collection quality, operator performance, and session outcomes - Collaborate with research teams to refine annotation guidelines and quality criteria - Maintain quality metrics and contribute to reporting on dataset health across collection campaigns Validation & System Integration - Verify that hardware, software packages, and peripherals work smoothly together across the robotics stack - Run tests in lab and staging environments, log bug reports, and contribute to root-cause analysis of recurring or production issues - Support test plan execution by following defined acceptance criteria and documenting results - Maintain detailed operational documentation for internal quality gates and runbooks What We're Looking For - Comfortable working hands-on with physical hardware: diagnosing, setting up, and maintaining equipment - Strong communicator who can work fluidly with both engineers and non-technical operators - Able to work autonomously and exercise independent judgment on methods and execution Nice to Have - Familiarity with robotics and teleoperation systems - Background in a research or hardware-forward environment - Experience writing operational runbooks or technical documentation WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Energy Procurement & Policy
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE TEAM Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center. The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years. Every megawatt needs power, and power is this role's domain. THE ROLE Mistral's data centers will consume hundreds of megawatts of electricity. This hire makes sure that power is reliable and affordable. You will define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy: structuring agreements with utilities, hedging against volatile spot prices, and tracking the regulatory changes that affect where and how data centers can be powered. The role also touches energy policy and community relations in the regions where Mistral operates. This is a hybrid seat. Roughly half of the work is commercial: procurement contracts, hedging instruments, and price risk management. The other half is policy and positioning: monitoring regulation, engaging with grid operators and local authorities, and helping Mistral build the social license to operate large data centers across Europe. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Define and execute Mistral's energy procurement strategy across European data center sites - Negotiate power purchase agreements and procurement contracts with utilities - Structure hedging agreements to limit exposure to volatile spot power prices - Monitor energy regulation and policy developments that affect data center siting, grid connection, and power pricing - Engage with grid operators, regulators, and local communities in regions where Mistral builds and operates data centers WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - You have procured energy at scale. You have structured power purchase agreements, utility contracts, or hedging instruments for industrial or infrastructure-scale consumers. - You understand European energy markets. You know how power pricing, grid connection, and regulation work across the markets where Mistral operates. - You can read a regulatory brief. You have tracked and interpreted energy or infrastructure policy and translated it into commercial implications. - You communicate across disciplines. You work effectively with engineers, finance, legal, and external stakeholders, and can explain complex energy concepts to non-specialists. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

You will be working closely with all relevant teams involved in our products. The role requires a combination of good planning and organizational skills. Focused on content distribution, work schedule optimization, hours distribution, and database compilation. Our mission is to help customers successfully adopt and operationalize AI across their organizations. You will work with engineers, AI and platform teams, administrators, security stakeholders, product leaders, and executive sponsors. items.title: Technical Program Manager, Capacity Analytics & Tooling
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Compute Infrastructure team runs the GPU fleet and large-scale compute clusters that serve the models backing ChatGPT and the API, while also supporting training workloads for our next generation models. We operate a large, modern GPU fleet and provide a unified platform for other OpenAI teams to run production Applied AI and Research training workloads. We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. Safety is more important to us than unfettered growth. ABOUT THE ROLE You will join the Compute Infrastructure TPM team as a Technical Program Manager for Capacity Analytics & Tooling. You will serve as the product manager for our supply and demand planning tools, owning the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of the systems teams use to forecast demand, understand supply, and plan allocations. Your users will include Product TPMs, Capacity TPMs, and Compute TPMs, alongside partners across Finance, Accounting, Leadership, Engineering, and Research. This role combines product management, technical program leadership, data engineering, and applied data science. You will partner with engineering and data teams to build reliable data foundations, improve forecasting and scenario planning, and scale our tools and success metrics across CPU, storage, network, and GPU resources. You will help teams make informed capacity decisions across AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, and other infrastructure providers. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own the product strategy and roadmap for supply and demand planning tools. Understand user needs, set priorities, define success measures, and guide delivery from initial requirements through adoption and ongoing improvement. - Build useful planning workflows. Translate complex processes into tools for demand intake, forecasting, supply tracking, scenario analysis, and allocation planning. Our work spans cloud providers, bare metal infrastructure, data centers, and the foundational services that make compute usable. We partner across Engineering, Research, Product, Capacity Planning, Finance, and Data Center Infrastructure to bring new capacity online and support OpenAI’s growing compute needs. You will own the roadmap, requirements, delivery, and adoption of the tools, data, and platform behind that signal, partnering with Engineering to build systems that support planning and execution across OpenAI. You will also lead programs that turn incoming supply into usable compute. Working across cloud providers, Data Center Infrastructure, and compute engineering teams, you will connect physical site readiness with the CPU, storage, network, GPU, and foundational services required to bring new sites and clusters online. You will be part of an engineer-first TPM team, managing a broad portfolio of infrastructure programs and making dependencies, risks, and decisions clear from working teams through leadership. Your work will help teams plan with confidence, respond to supply changes, and deliver capacity on time. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own the GPU supply signal across the fleet. items.title: Content Designer
items.description: Perplexity is looking for a Content Designer to shape the words across our products. You'll design the language people see and hear across our family of Perplexity apps, from the first screen of onboarding to the way an agent explains what it's doing. Fundamentally, we are all writers. Our product is primarily spoken language and written product; but as we scale, we want someone who will continue to work on clarity, usefulness, and keep it unmistakably Perplexity. You're a designer first? You're an engineer first? You're a writer first? Your shape is not conventional, and you wear many hats. You are fluent in AI tooling. You have strong UX fundamentals and good product instincts. You use language to solve product problems: flows, naming, information architecture, error states, permissions, and moments where people need to trust what the product is telling them. You command words. You command agents, and make decisions about words. You can write one perfect line, and you can build the system that keeps thousands of lines consistent. You'll sit on the Design Systems team and work closely with product designers, engineers, PMs, research, brand, and marketing. (Again) You're fluent in AI-powered tools and use it every day. You understand how models behave, how prompts and system instructions shape what people see, and how to define and judge quality when the output isn't fully deterministic. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and write in-product language across web, mobile, desktop, and voice, including UI copy, flows, onboarding, notifications, empty states, errors, and in-product education - Partner with product designers from the start of a project, shaping flows, structure, and information architecture as well as the words in them - Name features and products, and own terminology, navigation labels, and taxonomies so the product stays easy to understand as it grows - Make complex AI and agent behavior understandable, including what the product is doing, why, what it can't do, and when it needs a person's input - Shape how AI-generated content reads by writing and refining prompts and system instructions, and help define voice and response style for our models in product - Define content quality standards and help build evaluation criteria, datasets, and reviewer guidance for AI-generated content - Build and maintain voice and tone guidelines, content patterns, and content guidance in our design system so every team can write well - Use research, data, and experiments to test language and improve comprehension, activation, and task completion - Partner with brand and marketing so product language and our external voice feel like one company - Work with internationalization partners so the product reads well in every language we support - Review copy in code and ship small language changes directly when it's the fastest path WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or product design, shipping software at scale - An excellent portfolio that shows how your language shaped product decisions, with clear before and after examples and your role in each - Strong UX fundamentals, including interaction design, information architecture, usability, and accessibility - Good product sensibility and judgment about what to build, what to cut, and what matters most to people - Exceptional writing and editing skills, with range from precise interface copy to clear explanations and confident naming - Strong AI fluency, including hands-on experience writing prompts, working with LLMs, and judging the quality of AI-generated content - Systems thinking, with experience building content frameworks, style guides, or terminology that scale across teams - Clear communication, with the ability to explain content decisions and tradeoffs to designers, engineers, and leaders - You care about shipping great software more than anything else NICE TO HAVE - Experience designing content for AI products, assistants, agents, or conversational interfaces - Experience with prompt engineering, model evals, or working with research teams on model behavior - Experience across consumer and enterprise products, including admin, permissions, privacy, and billing flows - Comfort working in code, such as editing strings, reviewing PRs, or prototyping with AI tools - Experience with localization and writing for global audiences NOTES FOR CANDIDATES We want to see portfolio work where your words changed the product. Show us the problem, the options you explored, the language you shipped, and what happened after. We value end-to-end ownership, range, and impact, and we'd love to see examples of AI-related work, such as prompts, evaluations, or content you designed for model output.

items.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Product Manager on the Payments Platform team within the Platform product group, you'll own how customers add and use bank accounts, cards, and digital wallets on Coinbase. Payments Platform builds and runs the systems that move customer money in and out of Coinbase, covering bank transfers, card payments, wires and real-time rails. Your work sits directly on revenue and customer trust: if a customer can't add a payment method, nothing else happens. What you’ll do: Own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for how customers add and use bank accounts, cards, and digital wallets on Coinbase, including the full funnel from first screen through linking, verification, and failure recovery. Drive intelligent routing of payment onboarding across multiple payment service providers and banks, picking the path most likely to succeed and cheapest to run so a single provider problem never becomes a customer outage. Shape the approach for confirming that a payment method belongs to the customer, partnering with Risk and Compliance to hold a measured line on fraud loss versus conversion. Partner with Business Development and external bank and processor partners on commercial terms, integrations, and the next wave of payment capabilities. Lead payment method cost and performance reporting end to end, surfacing tradeoffs to senior leadership and building platform capabilities that other product teams can reuse without rebuilding the plumbing. Required Skills and Experience: 7+ years of product management experience with depth in payments, money movement, or financial platforms, and a track record of owning a payment or money movement funnel end to end at scale with measurable results. Working knowledge of how card payments and bank transfers actually work, including declines, retries, verification, tokenization, and routing, with the ability to go deep with engineers on service architecture, APIs, and routing logic. Strong analytical instincts, including designing experiments and holding a measured line on tradeoffs when the easy answer and the right answer are not the same. items.description: About the Team OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. About the Role We are looking for an accountant to own an assigned portfolio of intercompany and investment accounting processes. You will manage recurring reconciliations, coordinate the accounting for intercompany funding, review transfer pricing calculations and journal entries, and partner with Technical Accounting on investments. A fundamental part of the role is understanding OpenAI's group structure, partnering closely with Tax on complex transactions, and providing guidance to the wider accounting group on intercompany flows. You will own work from source data through close, resolve routine issues independently, and improve processes within established policies and approval controls. You will identify matters requiring technical assessment early and bring clear analysis and supporting facts for review. You will be a pivotal interface between global finance teams, treasury, tax, and systems to support our mission-critical financial close and reporting processes. What You Will Do - Develop and maintain an understanding of OpenAI's group structure, ownership relationships and intercompany arrangements and flows. - Partner with Tax, Technical Accounting and your manager to assess complex intercompany transactions and coordinate implementation of agreed accounting treatments. - Provide guidance to the wider accounting group on intercompany flows, accounting treatments and cross-entity accounting questions. - Own monthly and quarterly close activities for assigned accounts, including reconciliations and resolution of reconciling items. - Coordinate accounting for intercompany funding and settlements with Treasury and Tax, within established approval and execution controls. - Review transfer pricing calculations prepared by the TP team for intercompany accounting accuracy, including entity, account, currency and FX rate treatment. - Prepare and review assigned journal entries for accuracy, supporting evidence and consistency with approved accounting treatments and controls. - Maintain investment accounting records and reconciliations, implement agreed accounting treatments, and partner with Technical Accounting and your manager on new transactions and technical assessments. - Maintain close and audit support, document processes and controls, and work with systems teams to improve accounting workflows and resolve reporting issues. What You Will Bring - Experience owning recurring accounting work through close, including balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, and investigation of reconciling items. - A working understanding of US GAAP and multi-entity accounting, with the judgment to distinguish routine application of established policy from matters that need technical review. - Familiarity with intercompany transactions, settlements, and foreign currency accounting. Experience with transfer pricing calculations or investment accounting is relevant to this role. - Careful review habits and the ability to trace a calculation or journal entry to its source, explain discrepancies, and document how they were resolved. - The ability to organize a close calendar, manage dependencies, and communicate clearly with Accounting, Treasury, Tax, and Technical Accounting. You follow through independently and raise issues with enough context for others to act. - Comfort working with spreadsheets and accounting systems. Experience with Oracle FCCS or a similar consolidation system, internal controls, or audit support would be useful. What Success Looks Like - Your assigned close activities are completed on time, with accurate entries and reconciliations that are easy to review. - Reconciling items are resolved promptly, and unresolved issues have clear owners and next steps. - Funding, transfer pricing, and investment accounting records reflect approved transactions and treatments, with complete supporting evidence. - Documented processes and practical improvements reduce rework, while complex or unusual matters reach your manager early enough for a considered decision. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.title: Manager, Global BPO Management
items.location_text: Chicago, IL; Denver, CO; Westlake, TX
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Global BPO Management team , within Robinhood Customer Care Operations, is responsible for the strategy, governance, performance, and commercial management of Robinhood's global Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) partner network. We support key operational areas including Customer Experience, Financial Crimes, Fraud, Account Operations, and Credit to ensure our partners operate efficiently and compliantly. Our team fosters a collaborative and supportive culture that values analytical rigor, open feedback, and continuous learning. We work closely with our partners to deliver exceptional support experiences to our customers! Together, we focus on building scalable solutions that help democratize finance for everyone. As the Manager, Global BPO Management , you will lead and develop a team of Vendor Managers and Performance Analysts. You will serve as the strategic owner of Robinhood's outsourced operations, overseeing partner relationships, operational performance, and commercial health. In this role, you will collaborate with teams in Product, Finance, and Compliance to drive long-term network strategy and risk diversification. You will balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution to help optimize processes and reduce operating costs. Your leadership will directly influence partner performance and ensure our customers receive high-quality care! This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Denver, CO and Westlake, TX offices, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Lead, coach, and develop a team of Vendor Managers and Performance Analysts, fostering a culture of accountability, analytical rigor, and continuous professional growth. Serve as the primary relationship owner for our global BPO partner network, overseeing operational performance, service delivery, and compliance across all partners. Establish operational reporting frameworks and analytical models to translate performance metrics into clear, actionable business strategies. Drive continuous process improvement and cost optimization by conducting root cause analysis and implementing scalable operational solutions. Coordinate with internal department leaders in Product, Finance, and Legal to execute vendor agreements, manage budgets, and align vendor operations with company goals. What you bring 8+ years of experience in vendor management, BPO, or operational leadership within financial services or technology, including 4+ years of experience managing and developing teams. Proven track record of managing global vendor networks, including executing operational governance, service level agreements, and financial budgeting. Strong analytical skills with experience using platforms like Looker, Tableau, or SQL to translate operational metrics into clear strategic decisions. Experience negotiating and managing commercial contracts, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Statements of Work (SOWs). FINRA Series 7, 63, and 9/10 or Series 24 licenses (strongly preferred, or willingness to obtain). Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform. About the Role We’re looking for a Silicon Design Lead to drive architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of key IP and subsystems for our AI hardware platforms. You will translate functional, performance, and security requirements into efficient silicon designs, owning technical decisions from architectural definition through implementation and integration. Part of this role will focus on hardware security implementation in close partnership with OpenAI’s Security team. While the Security team owns the overarching security architecture and requirements, you will translate those requirements into silicon microarchitecture and implementation, balancing security capabilities with performance, power, area, and design complexity. The other part of this role will focus on driving general silicon architecture/microarchitecture. In this role, you will: - Own architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of silicon IP and subsystems, from requirements and design specifications through integration and validation. - Define hardware interfaces, data flows, and microarchitectural tradeoffs to meet functional, performance, power, and area requirements. - Partner closely with OpenAI’s Security team to translate security architecture, requirements, and threat models into implementable hardware capabilities. - Design and integrate hardware security mechanisms, including encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, and data protection across silicon subsystems. - Evaluate architectural and implementation tradeoffs to ensure security capabilities meet functional and performance requirements. - Collaborate with silicon architects, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive subsystem design, integration, and validation. - Review and contribute to RTL implementations, ensuring designs align with architectural intent and system requirements. - Evaluate existing and third-party IP, identify architectural or implementation gaps, and drive solutions across subsystem boundaries. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have strong experience in silicon IP or subsystem-level architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation. - Have owned hardware IP or subsystem designs from architectural definition through implementation and integration. - Have experience implementing hardware security features such as memory encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, or secure boot. - Understand how to translate functional and security requirements into hardware architectures, interfaces, and microarchitectural specifications. - Have working knowledge of RTL design and coding proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog, with the ability to read, review, and contribute to RTL. - Can evaluate performance, power, area, and complexity tradeoffs across silicon designs. - Work effectively across security, silicon architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive designs from concept through execution. - Ideally, have broader SoC-level architecture or integration experience, though deep IP or subsystem-level expertise is sufficient. items.title: Procurement Operations Business Partner - Workplace, Security and People
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Procurement Operations is the front door for buying at Anthropic. We sit inside Finance Operations and own the path from "I need to buy something" to a signed agreement, an accurate purchase order, and clean spend data at month end. We are hiring a Procurement Operations Business Partner to own that path for the teams that keep Anthropic's offices, people, and physical spaces running. Workplace covers real estate, office build outs and leases, furniture and equipment, facilities services, maintenance, and food and beverage. Security covers physical security: guard services, access control and badging, cameras, and security consulting that protect our offices and people. People covers recruiting agencies and recruiting operations, HR systems, benefits and Total Rewards vendors, and training and development. You will be the person who makes all of it feel simple to the teams who depend on it and reliable to the Finance stakeholders behind it. This is a high volume role with an accounting core. You ensure every purchase in your portfolio is coded, dated, received, and accrued correctly, so spend is right in the books every month. Expect a steady queue of requests, statements of work, change orders, and renewals, and expect to be the person Accounting trusts on all of it. We use Claude as part of our daily workflow and are looking for someone who wants to help define what an AI native procurement operations function looks like, including how AI changes intake, document review, vendor coordination, and requester support. Responsibilities Own the purchasing process Manage a high volume of purchase requests, statements of work, change orders, and renewals each month across Workplace, Security, and People, keeping speed and accuracy high at the same time. Serve as the primary procurement partner by guiding requesters from initial request to signed agreement and issued purchase order. Review every purchase request for the things that matter downstream: the right vendor record and contracting entity, complete commercial documents, correct spend categorization and service dates, and the approvals the purchase actually needs. Determine what each request requires before it can move, whether that is a statement of work, an amendment, a lease review, a privacy review, or a third party risk assessment, and route it to the right reviewers the first time. Partner with Privacy, Security, and Third Party Risk on vendors that handle employee or candidate data or have physical access to our offices, such as badging and camera systems, background check providers, and on site service staff. Hold the line that nothing goes live without the review it needs. Launch and track contract review with Legal and outside counsel, keep it moving, and confirm the executed agreement supports the purchase order before it is issued. Structure purchase orders so they match how the vendor bills (fixed fee, milestone or progress billing, time and materials, per placement, per head, or recurring monthly service) and how Accounting needs to see the spend, with the right GL account, cost center, and service period on every line. Manage change orders, renewals, and closures over the life of each agreement. Handle the mechanics that come with physical work and goods: multi line quotes, deposits, lead times, receiving, and asset handoffs for furniture, fixtures, and equipment. Know where a purchase belongs. Not everything in these categories should run through a purchase order, and you help requesters tell the difference between a contract that needs Procurement and spend that belongs on a card. Financial completeness and accuracy Code every purchase order correctly at creation, including GL account, spend category, cost center, and service period, and understand how each choice lands in the financials: capitalized build out and equipment versus operating spend, deposits and prepaids versus expense, and lease versus non lease costs. Work the hard cases with Accounting: progress billed construction, retainage, partially delivered milestones, guard services billed in arrears against changing staffing schedules, placement fees tied to start dates and guarantee periods, credits and true ups, and change orders that land mid month. Understand what a contract actually commits us to, including term, termination for convenience, and notice periods, so firm commitment reporting reflects the real exposure. Own the open purchase order book: receipts recorded against actual delivery, periodic reviews, stale line cleanup, coding corrections, and timely closures, so PO, receipt, and invoice agree. Serve as the first line reviewer for month end accruals on your portfolio, gathering estimates from vendors and budget owners for variable spend and confirming or correcting proposed amounts so Accounting can close on time. Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve invoice holds, PO mismatches, and receiving questions so vendors are paid on time and spend lands where it belongs. Support audit and reporting requests that touch your portfolio, including commitment schedules and control evidence, with data you can stand behind. Be the front door Be visible and responsive in your teams' Slack channels and office hours; answer routine purchasing questions quickly and escalate real blockers with context. Apply purchasing policy consistently and explain the why, including approval thresholds, signature authority, and when an exception is and is not available. Translate procurement, legal, privacy, and finance requirements into plain language for Workplace, Security, and People teams, and carry their operating reality back to those teams so controls fit the work. An office opening date, a guard post that has to be staffed tonight, or a recruiting search that has to start this week are real constraints, and you plan around them. Keep a regular check in with your highest volume teams so upcoming office projects, renewals, staffing changes, and searches are visible early and nothing urgent arrives as a surprise. Continuous improvement Maintain the playbooks, intake guidance, and standard operating procedures for your portfolio so the path is repeatable and does not live in one person's head. Identify manual steps, repeat questions, and failure points and fix them, including where Claude and workflow automation can take work off requesters and the team. Minimum qualifications 5 to 7+ years of procurement operations, purchasing, or vendor operations, including time supporting Workplace or Facilities, Security, or People teams. Proven track record of owning a high volume purchasing portfolio end to end in a procure to pay and intake platform. Solid working knowledge of accrual accounting as it applies to purchasing: accruals and reversals, service period and cutoff, prepaid versus expense, capital versus operating spend, and GL and cost center coding. You can explain how a purchase order becomes an entry in the general ledger. Experience managing services vendors on master agreements with statements of work and change orders, where scope moves and the contract, the PO, and the invoice have to stay in sync. Experience with facilities, real estate, or construction purchasing, including milestone or progress billing and receiving against physical delivery. Working knowledge of how contract review, privacy and security review, and financial controls fit together in a purchase, and the judgment to know when to push a request through and when to slow it down. Preferred qualifications Experience with office build outs, leases, or fixed asset purchasing, including furniture, fixtures, and equipment, and working alongside Lease Accounting or Fixed Assets. Experience buying physical security services or systems, such as guard services, access control, or video surveillance. Experience with recruiting agencies, contingent workforce, or HR and benefits vendors, including the privacy review that comes with employee and candidate data. Background in accounting, accounts payable, or a month end close process. Direct experience with Zip, Workday Financials, and Ironclad. Prior ownership of month end accrual review or open PO reconciliation for a large, variable spend portfolio. Experience designing tiered intake or approval frameworks that sped up low risk purchases without weakening controls. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $190,000 — $230,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Deployment Strategist Lead - Middle East
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate. items.title: Business Recruiter
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the Role Anthropic is growing quickly across EMEA, and we need recruiters who can help us hire exceptional people into the teams that keep the company running and bring our work to customers. We’re looking for a Recruiter to join our Talent team in London to own full-cycle recruiting for either our G&A functions (Finance, Legal, People, and related areas) and our Go-To-Market organization (Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer-facing roles), depending on business need and your background. This is a full-cycle individual-contributor role for a strong recruiter who can run an excellent process end to end—sourcing, screening, managing stakeholders, and closing. You’ll partner with hiring managers across EMEA to understand what great looks like, build healthy pipelines, and deliver a candidate experience that reflects Anthropic’s values. You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift, and you’ll have real ownership over the roles you run. We’re open to candidates whose strength is in G&A recruiting or in GTM recruiting; in your application, tell us where your experience is deepest. Key Responsibilities Own full-cycle recruiting for a portfolio of G&A or GTM roles across EMEA—from intake through offer and close Partner with hiring managers to scope roles, calibrate the bar, and build effective sourcing strategies Source and engage high-quality active and passive candidates, building diverse and competitive pipelines Run structured, rigorous, and candidate-centric interview processes that uphold Anthropic’s hiring bar Manage candidates through the process with clear communication and a great experience at every stage Collaborate with the broader Talent team, People Partners, and Compensation to structure offers and guide candidates to close Use data to track pipeline health and share insight that helps hiring managers make good decisions Minimum Qualifications 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in either G&A (Finance, Legal, People) or GTM (Sales, Marketing, Partnerships) hiring Track record of closing strong candidates in competitive markets Familiarity with the EMEA talent landscape and comfort recruiting across multiple countries Strong stakeholder management—you build trust and partnership with hiring managers Excellent organization and the ability to manage multiple searches at once without dropping details Clear, direct communication style and a bias toward action Comfort operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment Genuine interest in Anthropic’s mission and the role recruiting plays in achieving it Preferred Qualifications Experience recruiting at a high-growth technology, AI, or machine learning company Experience recruiting across both G&A and GTM functions Experience hiring across multiple EMEA markets, including the UK and Ireland Familiarity with Greenhouse or similar ATS platforms Additional European language skills relevant to hiring across the region The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €170.000 — €215.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Product Content Creator
items.description: About the Team The B2B Content team helps business audiences understand what AI makes possible and how to put it to work. We develop narrative, editorial, demo, and adoption programs that connect OpenAI’s products to concrete business value. We partner closely with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Customer Education, Sales, and other teams to create content that is useful on its own and supports the broader customer journey. We value people who are eager to learn, have a bias for action, and look beyond the immediate deliverable. We build the tools, systems, and shared practices that help the whole team produce better work over time. About the Role We’re looking for a Product Content Creator to help create the next generation of AI-native marketing content. You’ll develop videos, interactive tutorials, live demos, written guides, and other experiences that help business audiences understand what AI makes possible and how it applies to their work. This is a hands-on creative role spanning demand generation and product adoption. You’ll explore product capabilities, build and test workflows, and produce content for campaigns that introduce people to useful ideas and help them put those ideas into practice. You’ll maintain evergreen campaign content and develop new adoption campaigns, using practical workflows, research, and thought leadership as source material. You’ll use Codex and other AI tools to prototype ideas and create experiences that would previously have required a larger production team. We’re looking for the fluency of a coding-assistant power user; an engineering background isn’t required. Strong judgment about the idea, the audience, and the finished experience matters as much as the ability to build it. You’ll partner with Product Marketing on positioning and product accuracy, Demand Generation on campaign goals and distribution needs, and Demo Studio on demonstrations and production. You’ll own the content from concept through delivery, choosing the format that best serves the idea and the audience. This is an individual-contributor role for someone who enjoys making, explaining, experimenting, and shipping. The role is hybrid and will be based in San Francisco, Monday through Wednesday. Thursday and Friday are work-from-home days, with occasional in-office attendance as needed for live webinars. In this role, you will: - Develop creative concepts and produce content for Demand Generation campaigns, grounded in audience needs, product workflows, research, and expert perspectives. - Personally create videos, interactive tutorials, live demos, and written guides, carrying work from the initial idea through a finished asset. - Use Codex and other AI tools to build and test workflows, prototype interactive experiences, and improve how content is produced. - Develop and test original content formats, learn from audience response, and turn the strongest ideas into recurring series or reusable campaign experiences. Choose formats for what they help the audience understand or do. - Develop webinar content with the webinar strategist, including the storyline, presentation, demonstration, and useful follow-up resources. - Work with Product Marketing, subject-matter experts, and Demo Studio to make content accurate, substantive, and engaging. - Work with customer-facing teams to learn how people actually use the products, where they get stuck, and which workflows are worth demonstrating. Use those insights to develop relevant stories and adoption content. - Adapt strong ideas across formats and audiences while giving each asset a clear purpose within the campaign. - Deliver usable campaign assets to Demand Generation, with clear audience framing, supporting copy, and a proposed next action. - Use audience feedback and campaign results with DG to improve the content, and keep reusable workflows, examples, and source material current. - Maintain evergreen campaign content, updating workflows, demonstrations, and supporting resources as products and audience needs change. - Create adoption campaign content that helps people try relevant workflows, overcome common difficulties, and continue using them in their work. - Review campaign results and audience feedback with partners to understand both what attracts interest and what helps people successfully use the product. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have a portfolio of substantive content you personally created across several formats, such as video, interactive tutorials, live demos, and written guides. Work projects, side projects, and experiments driven by your own curiosity are all relevant—we want to understand what you made and the decisions behind it. - Are a confident user of Codex or comparable coding assistants and can show how you used them to build, test, and improve something useful. An engineering background isn’t required. - Bring strong creative and editorial judgment: you can recognize an interesting idea, explain why a format works, and improve an experience beyond the first version. - Can learn a product deeply enough to demonstrate real workflows and explain them clearly to business audiences with different levels of technical fluency. - Write clearly, communicate well on video or in live demonstrations, and can turn complex material into something people want to spend time with. - Understand how content supports marketing campaigns and can work with Demand Generation on audience needs, campaign goals, and what the results suggest changing. - Take ownership from an ambiguous brief through delivery, balancing experimentation with the practical work required to ship. - May have developed these skills in product marketing, developer relations, product education, creative technology, or content marketing. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Product Creative team is a small but mighty group embedded within Robinhood’s broader product design organization. We work cross-functionally with designers, product managers, engineers, and other creative teams to build and ship world-class product experiences, and uphold and evolve Robinhood’s distinctive identity. Our team believes in raising the bar on visual craft while maintaining system scalability and cohesion across every touchpoint. As a Staff Visual Designer on the Product Creative team, you’ll help define and shape Robinhood’s product design language. This role is ideal for a highly experienced individual contributor who thrives on ownership, brings deep expertise in visual design systems, and collaborates with teams across the company to ship iconic, user-centric work. You’ll work on high-impact product launches and the visual systems that power Robinhood’s growing suite of products. This role is based in our Bellevue, WA, Menlo Park, CA, and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners including designers, engineers, and product managers to shape visual direction and ensure consistency across the Robinhood product suite. Design and evolve aspects of Robinhood’s design language – including icons, color schemes, and UI components across the product. Support Robinhood’s high-impactest product launches with strong attention to visual craft and storytelling. Evolve our internal design system to be AI-ready and support new aesthetics and functionality. Advocate for design excellence and provide mentorship through critique and shared best practices. What you bring Deep expertise in visual design and exceptional attention to detail across typography, layout, color, and composition. Proven experience designing and evolving scalable design systems in a product environment. Strong communication skills with the ability to influence and advocate for design decisions across teams. Mastery of design tools such as Figma, plus experience with generative AI design tools (e.g., MidJourney, Lovable, Magic Patterns, etc) is a plus. Experience navigating complex stakeholder environments and balancing design rigor with business needs. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. items.title: Devops Engineer
items.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1000 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association . In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification . EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Devops engineer join our team in Lviv! What You'll get to do: You will be responsible for resolving issues with Linux or Windows hosts, analyzing logs and investigating any potential application/system misconfiguration. Working closely with other Devops you will be involved in improvement of existing and creating new CI-CD configurations, Ansible playbooks and Terraform modules to provide better and faster deployment of application and rollout of new environments. Linux/Windows VM administration and maintenance, updating packages with IAC, debugging issues CI-CD pipelines analyses, maintenance and updates Dockerfiles optimization and improvements Monitoring, analyze dashboards, create new one if needed, provide feedback to Dev/OP team Investigation of any reported/potential issues using ES service Basic support of infrastructure/application deployments Incident and Operation team support with their issues What You need to know: Linux administration - command line, user and permission management, basic networking, Systemd and Journald services, SSH, debugging tools. - is a must Scripting - bash, Python, or any additional language will be a plus Containerization - basic understanding of Docker, Dockerfile and similar technologies; working experience will be a plus CI-CD - understanding and familiarity with continuous integration and delivery tools(like GitLab (preferably)/Github, Circle CI, ArgoCD or any other) Cloud Platform - basic understanding of cloud platforms(GCP preferably) any experience will be a plus Orchestration - any experience with Terraform/Cloudformation/ArgoCD or any other IAC tools will be a plus Automation - basic understanding and experience with automation tools like Ansible(preferably)/Puppet/Saltstuck Monitoring tools - understanding of monitoring systems and basic experience with at least one of Nagios/Promethes/Grafana/Coralogic or any similar one. Nice to have: Windows Server administration(Agent level) Kubernetes - any experience Logging tools - hands on with Elasticsearch(preferably)/Opensearch/Loki/ or any similar in working environment Message brokers - any experience with Redis/Rabbitmq/Kafka. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required; 30 medical leave days with medical allowance Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment with 80/20 office/home format. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and a budget for external training. Gym allowance. Corporate English lessons. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include on-site massages and frequent team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference!
