items.title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy. Responsibilities: Strategic Technical Partnership : Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues. Joint Solution Development: Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment Customer Deal Support: Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance. Partner Ecosystem & Events : Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities. Product Feedback: Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy. You may be a good fit if you have: 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Applied Scientist Lead - Robotics, EMEA
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE Mistral AI is seeking a Lead / Staff Applied Scientist to help lead our robotics research and industrial collaborations in the Applied Science team. You will set the technical direction for robotics, and design, train, and deploy SOTA robotics models (VLM, VLA models for navigation and manipulation) with our industrial partners. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Set the technical direction for robotics in Applied Science: which problems, models, data, and benchmarks we invest in. - Lead the technical execution of high-stakes robotics projects with customers and partners, from scoping to deployment. - Build and mentor a team of robotics Applied Scientists and Research Engineers. - Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on clusters with thousands of GPUs. - Own the data strategy: generate and curate datasets (image-text, video-text, teleoperation, simulation), and build evaluators/benchmarks for perception, navigation and manipulation tasks. - Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases. - Manage research projects and communications with client research teams, and engage senior stakeholders. ABOUT YOU - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills — at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Experience leading a technical AI, science or engineering team. Balancing technical IC work with team leadership and stakeholder management. - Expert with PyTorch or JAX. - Deep experience with Vision Language Models (VLM), Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, perception, navigation and manipulation, simulation tools (e.g. Isaac SIM), with a track record of shipping models on real robots. - Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance. - Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code. - Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence. - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn. - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia. NICE TO HAVE - Ex-founder or builder - PhD / Master in a relevant field (Robotics, Machine Learning) — exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome. - Experience with sim-to-real transfer, world models, or large-scale robot data collection. - Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale. - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase. - Publications in top academic journals or conferences. - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Solutions Engineer (EMEA Shift)
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: The Solution Engineer role sits within the GTM organisation in India, making you a trusted technical advisor to the local sales team, our partners, and our customers. In this role, you will support the EMEA region, working closely with EMEA Account Executives, partners, and customers. You will work on exciting projects with some of the most forward-thinking organisations, helping guide the start of their Generative AI journeys. This role has a strong technical skill set and is not a classic SE profile. At Glean, our Solution Engineers work with our customers to help them connect Glean to their most important decision-making platforms. These platforms include Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Jira, Confluence, Slack, GitHub, Zendesk, and everything in between! As an SE, you will work closely with our Account Executives (AEs) and will be responsible for the technical success and delivery of our sales opportunities. You will: Perform interactive demonstrations of the Glean platform to prospective customers. Educate the technical teams of our prospective customers on the architecture of the Glean platform, specifically articulating the "how" of how our solution works in the context of the customer landscape. Scope and execute sponsored pilot and Proof of Value (PoV) exercises to ensure the technical requirements and business objectives that the Glean solution provides are validated. Educate and train our customers and partners on our product to ensure that they are set up for success. Present at company-sponsored events such as Google Cloud Next and AWS re:Invent. Liaise with Glean product managers and engineers to investigate issues, raise feature requests, and understand our future roadmap. About You: You have a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). You have at least 4+ years of experience in enterprise software pre-sales and have used value-based discovery frameworks. You possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex technical challenges. You are able to explain complex technical concepts in layman's terms to help educate and train our customers, prospects, and partners. You are comfortable presenting, both virtually and in person. You are familiar with cloud infrastructure (IaaS) platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure. You are familiar with identity services and Single Sign-On (SSO) providers such as Azure/Entra ID, Okta, and protocols such as SAML, SCIM, and OIDC. You are familiar with APIs, including sending and receiving data from API endpoints, and how to troubleshoot issues. You are familiar with security concepts and tools, e.g. Firewalls, VPNs, SSL/TLS, DLP, WAFs, and proxies. Location: This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office). This role supports the EMEA region, with working hours of 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST. Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We are a diverse bunch of people, and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy . items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior HR Project Manager to join our HR Transformation team, based in either our Stockholm office. In this brand-new role, you will play a critical part in helping us mature our people function and drive key strategic initiatives across LeoVegas Group. Reporting directly to the Director of HR Transformation, you will take ownership of high-impact people and workforce projects, and cross-functional HR frameworks. As a dedicated project lead, you will act as a vital bridge connecting different HR disciplines—including Talent Acquisition, Reward, L&D, and People Operations—with C-suite execs and senior business leaders. You will bring robust project discipline, clear governance, and commercial acumen to make sure our transformation initiatives run smoothly, stay on track, and deliver real value to the wider business. This is a fantastic opportunity for a structured project professional with a strong HR background to help deliver our global HR projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Leading end-to-end HR transformation projects. - Establishing clear project management structures, timelines, risk management, and reporting via project management tools. - Building strong relationships and comfortably managing senior stakeholders, including Directors and C-suite members. - Connecting different HR functions to ensure cross-team alignment, smooth communication, and clear project visibility. - Driving commercial HR conversations and guiding business leaders through operational change and maturity initiatives. - Escalating risks, removing blockers, and keeping complex short- and long-term project deliverables on track. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - A minimum of 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager, with a strong background in or deep working knowledge of HR functions. - Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders, with the credibility to command the room. - Exceptional communication, emotional intelligence, and conflict management skills when navigating complex change. - Strong commercial acumen and a structured, pragmatic approach to delivering business-aligned outcomes. - Experience working in a mature, fast-paced corporate environment (preferably across international locations). NICE TO HAVES - Exposure to AI transformation projects or leveraging modern AI tools within HR workflows. - Familiarity with project management software such as Monday.com http://Monday.com, Smartsheet, or MS Project. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We're a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - 30 annual vacation days - Occupational Pension - 5,000 SEK wellness contribution annually - Parental Leave Top-Up - Possibility to enrol in a private health care insurance for both you and your partner - 1,500 SEK equipment allowance - Benify - benefits portal with many offers and discounts JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don't wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. À propos du rôle Anthropic construit l’équipe Applied AI pour aider les organisations les plus ambitieuses du monde à adopter Claude de manière transformatrice, sûre et durable. Nos Forward Deployed Engineers s’intègrent directement auprès de clients stratégiques pour déployer des applications d’IA en production qui résolvent de véritables problèmes métier. À mesure que cette pratique se développe, nous avons besoin d’une personne leader pour construire et développer cette équipe. En tant que premier Forward Deployed Manager en Europe du Sud, vous piloterez l’équipe qui se situe à la frontière du déploiement d’IA en entreprise. Vous recruterez et développerez une équipe performante de Forward Deployed Engineers, fixerez le standard technique et opérationnel pour les engagements clients, et construirez les playbooks qui transforment les succès ponctuels en modèles reproductibles. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Engagement Managers qui gèrent la logistique de livraison et les relations avec les parties prenantes, tout en veillant à ce que votre équipe livre du code de qualité, se développe techniquement, et représente Anthropic au plus haut niveau dans les environnements clients. Ce rôle est un rôle de meneur-contributeur avec une forte orientation leadership. Vous resterez assez impliqué dans le travail technique pour examiner les architectures, déboguer les problèmes en production, et vous associer à votre équipe quand cela compte — mais votre impact principal viendra des personnes que vous recruterez, des standards que vous fixerez, et de la culture que vous créerez. Vous collaborerez de manière transversale avec les équipes Ventes, Produit et Ingénierie pour façonner la manière dont Anthropic sert ses clients les plus stratégiques, et les insights de terrain de votre équipe influenceront directement la direction produit. Ce rôle nécessite quelqu’un qui s’épanouit dans l’ambiguïté et qui est énergisé par la création à partir de zéro. Vous définirez ce que l’excellence ressemble pour la gestion d’une équipe FDE chez Anthropic — il n’existe pas de playbook existant à suivre. Responsabilités Recruter, développer et fidéliser une équipe de classe mondiale de Forward Deployed Engineers. Fixer un haut standard pour le talent technique et l’instinct client. Mener des entretiens individuels réguliers, fournir du mentorat technique, et investir dans la progression de carrière de chaque membre de l’équipe. Créer un environnement où les Forward Deployed Engineers accomplissent leur meilleur travail. Staffier et superviser les engagements clients dans le portefeuille de votre équipe, en prenant des décisions d’allocation des ressources qui équilibrent les besoins clients, le développement de l’équipe, et les priorités métier. Collaborer avec les équipes de compte et les Engagement Managers pendant le processus de pré-vente pour qualifier les engagements, définir le périmètre du travail, et informer les demandes de travail. Examiner les architectures techniques et le code produit par vos Forward Deployed Engineers, en veillant à ce que l’équipe livre des solutions production de haute qualité qui résolvent de véritables problèmes clients. Rester assez impliqué pour diriger des sessions de découverte technique, prototyper des solutions, et déboguer des problèmes complexes aux côtés de votre équipe quand cela est nécessaire. Construire des playbooks reproductibles, des dépôts de démarrage, des modèles d’intégration, et une base de connaissances interne qui capture ce que votre équipe apprend sur le terrain. Définir les OKRs de l’équipe liés aux résultats de succès client et aux objectifs d’adoption produit. Créer des cadences opérationnelles — standups, rétros, revues d’engagement — qui maintiennent l’équipe alignée. Collaborer avec Produit et Ingénierie pour traduire les insights de terrain en améliorations produit. Servir comme voix du client dans la planification interne. Voyager sur les sites des clients selon les besoins (25-50%), particulièrement lors des lancements d’engagement et pour les comptes prioritaires de votre équipe. Vous pourriez être un bon fit si vous avez 10+ ans d’expérience en ingénierie logicielle, architecture de solutions, ou dans un rôle technique orienté client comme l’ingénierie forward deployed ou le conseil. 2+ ans d’expérience en gestion de personnes au sein d’une organisation de services/post-vente/FDE avec un palmarès de recrutement, développement et fidélisation d’ingénieurs performants. De l’expérience dans la construction d’organisations de zéro à un, pas seulement l’héritage d’une organisation existante. De l’expérience de travail direct avec des clients d’entreprise sur des mises en œuvre techniques, y compris l’aisance à naviguer dans les dynamiques organisationnelles complexes. Une présence de cadre avec la capacité à naviguer fluidement entre les conversations stratégiques avec les parties prenantes senior et les sessions de débogage pratiques avec les ingénieurs. Des compétences fortes en communication écrite et verbale. Vous pouvez traduire la complexité technique en narratifs clairs pour des audiences diverses. Un enthousiasme sincère pour la construction de quelque chose de nouveau et la définition de l’excellence pour une équipe qui n’existe pas encore. Pourquoi ce rôle compte Vous serez une personne leader fondatrice d’une équipe qui définit comment les entreprises adoptent et déploient l’IA. Votre travail influencera directement la direction produit d’Anthropic, créera des modèles réutilisables pour la base clients plus large, et établira Anthropic comme le partenaire de confiance pour la transformation de l’IA — tout en promouvant le développement responsable des systèmes d’IA de pointe. About the role Anthropic is building the Applied AI team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it. As the first FDE Manager in Southern Europe, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments. This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction. This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow. Responsibilities Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts. Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers. Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities. Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work. Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems. Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed. Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field. Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned. Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning. Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts. You may be a good fit if you have 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting. 2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers. Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one. Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics. Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers. Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences. Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist. Why this role matters You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €235.000 — €295.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: About the Role As an Infrastructure Engineering Tech Lead at Betsson Group, you will provide technical leadership and direction across our infrastructure platforms, helping ensure that our environments are reliable, resilient, secure, scalable and well engineered. You will be a senior hands-on member of the Infrastructure team, combining deep technical expertise with the ability to guide engineering decisions, establish technical standards and support the development of engineers within the team. You will work closely with Infrastructure Engineers, architects, technical leadership and other technology teams to shape the evolution of our infrastructure platforms, ensuring that solutions are designed with operational excellence, automation, standardisation and long-term sustainability in mind. This is a technical leadership role rather than a people-management position. You will lead through technical expertise, collaboration, mentoring and influence while remaining actively involved in engineering and delivery. What You’ll Work On Provide technical leadership and direction across our on-premises and cloud infrastructure platforms. Be a hands-on technical leader, contributing to the design, implementation and continuous improvement of infrastructure solutions. Act as a technical authority and escalation point for complex infrastructure challenges. Define and promote engineering standards, best practices and reusable technical patterns across the team. Champion Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation and standardisation to improve efficiency, consistency and scalability. Drive improvements in infrastructure reliability, resiliency, availability and performance. Identify and help address technical debt and infrastructure lifecycle risks, supporting platform modernisation. Provide technical mentoring and guidance to Infrastructure Engineers, encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous development. Collaborate with other technical teams to ensure solutions align with architecture, security and engineering standards. Contribute to the Infrastructure technical roadmap and evaluate opportunities for modernisation and continuous improvement. Participate in the Infrastructure team on-call roster. What You Bring Proven experience in a technical leadership role within an infrastructure or operations team. In-depth knowledge of infrastructure technologies, including on-premises solutions, physical servers, network equipment, and storage solutions. Experience with automation and Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Ansible and Terraform. Experience with cloud computing platforms, preferably with AWS Strong understanding of Windows and Linux environments. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead to the resolution of complex technical issues. Hold certifications such as MCSA, MCSE, CCNA, CCNP, Linux LPIC/RHCSA/RHCE, CKA, CKAD, CKS, and VMware VCP-DCV are highly desirable. Understanding of infrastructure monitoring, observability, performance and capacity management. Strong understanding of KPIs and SLAs. Ability to establish technical standards and influence engineering decisions across teams. Strong communication, collaboration and technical mentoring skills. Excellent project management and organizational skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. items.title: Salesforce Developer
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Salesforce Developer to design, develop, and continuously improve our Salesforce platform and its ecosystem of integrations. You will partner closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Engineering to build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support the full quote-to-cash and go-to-market lifecycle. This role is ideal for an experienced hands-on developer who can translate complex business requirements into maintainable Salesforce solutions, independently own technical delivery, and help establish strong engineering, testing, and release practices as Glean scales. You will: Drive the technical implementation of Salesforce enhancements, from technical design and development through testing, deployment support, documentation, and post-release issue resolution. Design and develop scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, validation rules, asynchronous processing, and platform automation. Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and internal and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, middleware, and integration patterns appropriate to the use case. Contribute to the evolution of Salesforce as the system of record for opportunity, quote, order, customer, and other go-to-market data. Support quote-to-cash capabilities, including Revenue Cloud or CPQ-related processes, product and pricing workflows, order management, approvals, and downstream fulfillment integrations. Translate business requirements into clear technical designs, data models, user experiences, and implementation plans. Establish and maintain high standards for code quality, test coverage, security, performance, observability, and long-term maintainability. Follow and contribute to deployment and release practices across environments, including source control, CI/CD, code reviews, release planning, and rollback readiness. Investigate production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes that prevent recurrence. Partner with administrators, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to balance speed, usability, technical debt, and platform governance. Contribute to Salesforce architecture, integration standards, documentation, and operating procedures as the platform and team grow. Collaborate with administrators, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions and continuously improve the platform. About you: 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including ownership of complex implementations in a fast-growing or enterprise environment. Strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, SOQL/SOSL, asynchronous Apex, and Salesforce platform capabilities. Experience designing and implementing integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, middleware, platform events, or comparable event-driven approaches. Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and security, governor limits, bulkification, performance optimization, and enterprise architecture principles. Experience with Sales Cloud and at least one of Revenue Cloud, CPQ, order management, billing, or other quote-to-cash capabilities. Experience with Salesforce DevOps practices, source-driven development, Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and structured release management. Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple functions. A track record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgment, and delivering reliable solutions in a changing environment. Experience working in an Agile delivery environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and independently driving technical delivery. Salesforce Platform Developer I and II certifications are preferred; additional architecture, integration, or Revenue Cloud certifications are a plus. An AI-first mindset and curiosity about using AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, development productivity, testing, documentation, and operational workflows. Location: This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office). Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs. We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day. The work sits where research meets product. We work with new models before they are public. When a model gains a new ability, we work out what it should look like as an API, build it, and ship it to developers on our own platform and on cloud platforms. Those decisions shape how developers first use each model. We also own API versioning and the evals that tell us a capability works in production. What you'll do You'll lead the design, build, and operation of API capabilities used by developers around the world. You'll work with research to understand what a new model can do and turn that into an interface that is simple, durable, and hard to misuse. You'll lead the API side of new model launches. You'll plan the work, track readiness across teams, resolve the issues that come up late, and see the launch through on the day. Between launches, you'll make the next one faster and safer. You'll set technical direction for work that spans several teams, write clear design proposals, review API designs from other teams, and mentor engineers on the team. Representative projects Lead API readiness for a Claude model launch, so that every feature works on day one across our API, SDKs, docs, and cloud partners Take a new model ability from research prototype to public API feature, from interface design to production rollout Build and operate tools such as web search and code execution under real traffic Automate the manual parts of a model launch Build the evals that catch a capability regression before a launch You might be a good fit if you: Have led technical projects that spanned several teams, from design through launch and operation Have designed and operated production distributed systems where correctness, latency, and availability all matter Have strong product sense and care about API design and developer experience Make sound technical decisions with incomplete information, as models and priorities change close to a launch Explain tradeoffs clearly to research, product, and go-to-market partners, including non-engineers Make the engineers around you better through design review and mentoring Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build, and review software Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI Strong candidates may also have: Building public APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms Working with large language models, including tool use, agents, or evals Running launches or migrations with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams Building tools for agents, such as search or code execution Storage, memory, or context systems at scale Integrating with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure Deadline to apply: None. items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . Coinbase Creative Studio operates at the intersection of art, culture, and technology. We create original, high-impact work that helps define the Coinbase brand and bring our products to life in differentiated ways. Our portfolio spans large-scale brand and product campaigns with month-long timelines, as well as high-priority assets that need to move from brief to delivery the same day. We partner closely with internal creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and some of the world’s leading agencies and production partners to deliver work across channels and formats. As Design Operations Manager, you will own and evolve the operating model that enables our design and motion teams to do their best work. You will sit at the center of our creative ecosystem, connecting people, processes, partners, and priorities across a diverse portfolio of work. You will own resource planning for full-time and contract design and motion talent, set resource and capacity strategy across the portfolio, and help scale the studio through a global ecosystem of agency and production partners. You will own the process for how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported, and lead selected creative initiatives across multiple workstreams. You will bring structure and clarity to a fast-moving environment while protecting the quality, timeliness, and ambition of the work. This role is ideal for an experienced design operations leader who has delivered creative work for world-class brands and products across a range of media, and who knows how to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution. What You’ll Do Define and own the design and motion operating model for Creative Studio, including how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported. Set resource and capacity strategy across a broad portfolio of creative work, balancing business priorities, timelines, skill sets, and team health. Build and scale a global ecosystem of contract talent, agencies, and production partners, including sourcing, onboarding, engagement, and management of external partner performance. Establish operating rhythms, planning systems, and reporting that give senior stakeholders clear visibility into capacity, priorities, risks, and delivery. Lead high-impact design and motion initiatives across multiple workstreams, ensuring the work meets a high bar for quality, scope, timeliness, and brand expression. Partner with creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and senior cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business priorities into executable creative plans. Identify bottlenecks and create scalable tools, processes, and solutions that increase the team’s speed, effectiveness, and ability to deliver exceptional work. Significant experience leading design operations, creative operations, production management, or a related function within a high-performing creative organization. A track record of delivering creative work for world-class brands and products across multiple media, channels, and complex business contexts. Proven experience developing resource strategy and managing global networks of contract design and motion talent, agencies, and production partners. Exceptional organizational judgment, with the ability to set priorities, anticipate tradeoffs, and create clarity across complex and shifting workstreams. As a Senior Associate, Compliance Model Governance on the Compliance team, you'll own quantitative testing, monitoring, and data quality for the AI and statistical models that power Coinbase's financial crime compliance programs, including transaction monitoring models. You'll sit between Compliance, Data Science, and Engineering, designing the tests, building the pipelines and dashboards that track model health, and ensuring every model in production is defensible to Internal Audit and regulators. Advanced SQL and Python skills with experience building monitoring dashboards and working in cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake or Databricks), including data lineage tracing and data quality rule design. items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Strategic Finance Data Science team helps OpenAI understand business performance and make informed decisions about growth, revenue, and resource allocation. We partner with Strategic Finance, Data Engineering, and business teams to build trusted metrics, explain what is changing, and support forecasting, planning, pricing, and investment decisions. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Data Scientist, Analytics Enablement to turn complex financial and business questions into reliable data products, clear analyses, and actionable recommendations. You will work across the analytical workflow: define the question, establish trustworthy metrics and datasets, investigate the drivers, and help partners act on the findings. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will combine the technical depth of analytics engineering with strong analytical judgment and close partnership with Strategic Finance. Your work will serve both executive reviews and the teams making day-to-day business decisions. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Define and maintain trusted metrics and analytical datasets for revenue, usage, customer performance, compute consumption, and margin, with clear definitions and appropriate product, customer, and cohort detail. - Build automated dashboards and recurring reporting that help Finance leaders and operating teams understand performance, spot changes, and prioritize investigation. - Explain movements in business results and variances against expectations by examining underlying drivers, validating data quality, and distinguishing evidence from assumptions. - Translate ambiguous questions about growth, retention, monetization, pricing, and resource efficiency into structured analyses and practical recommendations. - Partner with forecasting specialists and Finance to provide reliable inputs, driver analyses, and scenario assumptions for forecasts and long-range plans. - Work with Data Engineering to improve the quality and usability of underlying data, and develop reusable analytical models and workflows that reduce manual effort. - Communicate findings clearly, align stakeholders on trade-offs, and follow through to understand whether the analysis or data product improved the decision. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the role The Claude Partner Network is how consulting firms, systems integrators, and other services partners build practices around Claude. When a company chooses a partner, it wants to know which firms have done this work well, in its industry and for its use case. Specializations are how the program will give it: credentials showing that a partner has demonstrated expertise in a given domain area. As Partner Specializations Lead, you'll own this program end to end: the requirements a firm has to meet, the evidence review that decides who qualifies, the benefits that make a specialization worth earning, and the operating rhythm that keeps it credible year after year. Your job is to take an early framework into a structure that scales: opening it to thousands of partners, running evaluation cycles, and launching new specializations with cross-functional input. This role suits someone who likes owning a standard. You'll work with partner managers, operations, enablement, marketing, and industry teams who each hold a piece of the program, and with senior leaders at partner firms who care a great deal about the outcome. A specialization only means something if it's earned, so you'll need to be rigorous with evidence, consistent in your decisions, and firm and clear when the answer is no. Key responsibilities Own each specialization's requirements, evidence standards, and benefits, and keep them current as our products and the partner network change Run each evaluation cycle from invitation to decision: collect partner evidence, reconcile it against internal data, lead the review, and document every decision Make and defend qualification decisions, including borderline cases, and apply the standard consistently across firms of very different sizes Communicate outcomes to partner executives and their Anthropic account teams, including clear guidance for firms that did not qualify Open the program to the wider partner network, and recommend which specializations come next based on customer demand, partner readiness, and Anthropic's priorities Define the evidence standard for new specializations with Applied AI, Product, and industry go-to-market teams Coordinate the teams that deliver the program's benefits (marketing, the partner directory, field enablement, technical support) so that earning a specialization leads to something real Work with Partner Enablement so that partner learning paths and certifications support each specialization Build the operating rhythm: renewal, remediation periods, an appeals path, and the tracking and reporting that show whether the program is working Design the review process to scale, using Claude and automation so that routine steps don't depend on a person Write and maintain partner-facing guidance (program guide sections, FAQs, application materials), clear enough for a partner to know where it stands without asking us, and internal guidance for field teams Use program data to recommend where each requirement's bar should sit and when it should move, and bring those recommendations to partner leadership Minimum qualifications Experience owning an external-facing program with published requirements (a partner, channel, certification, accreditation, or similar program), including running at least one full evaluation, qualification, or renewal cycle Experience making qualification or eligibility decisions against a written standard and communicating those decisions, including declines, to senior external stakeholders Experience working with CRM or PRM data, such as Salesforce reports or a partner portal, as a regular part of your job Strong writing: able to produce clear program requirements, decision memos, and partner-facing guidance that need little editing Experience leading work to a fixed date across several teams you do not manage, such as operations, marketing, enablement, and field teams Work effectively where the process is still being built and the details are still changing Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial Preferred qualifications Experience designing or running a partner competency, specialization, or credential program at a technology company Experience with services partners (systems integrators, consultancies) from either side: managing them at a vendor, or building a practice around a vendor's technology at a firm, and an understanding of how those firms decide where to invest their people SQL or BI-tool skills sufficient to pull and check your own program data Experience taking a program from its first launch to a repeatable operating cycle Experience launching a program publicly with marketing and communications partners Enough technical depth to judge whether a partner's evidence of a software or AI deployment holds up Experience working with customers in regulated or specialized industries, such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector Experience designing partner benefits or incentives, and an understanding of how they change partner behavior Hands-on experience building AI workflows with Claude or similar tools, and curiosity about how AI changes professional services delivery The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. items.description: About the Team Financial Engineering (FinEng) builds the financial systems behind ChatGPT, Codex, and OpenAI’s API platform. These products serve people, developers, and businesses around the world. We make them easy to buy, use, and pay for. Our systems support everything from individual subscriptions to usage-based billing and complex enterprise agreements. We also build the foundations for how products are packaged, accessed, and used: product catalogs, SKUs and bundles, workspaces, entitlements, and usage metering. These systems connect what customers purchase to the capabilities they can access and the usage they can manage. That reach creates challenging engineering problems. We build services and data pipelines that handle large volumes of usage and transactions, keep payments, product access, and financial records consistent across systems, and adapt as products and pricing change. The same foundations must support a simple checkout and the detailed spending controls a large business needs. Your work will help teams launch new products faster and give customers confidence in what they are paying for. The work spans customer experiences, backend services, and data systems, with opportunities to influence technical design and see your work through to production. We’re hiring Staff+ engineers with strong backend experience. Experience in payments, billing, or financial systems is a strong plus, but not required. In this role, you will: - Design and build systems for purchasing, payments, subscriptions, and billing across OpenAI products and global markets. - Build product catalogs, SKUs, and bundles that let product teams launch new offerings and evolve how products are packaged. - Develop workspace and entitlement systems that connect purchases and subscriptions to product access for individuals and teams. - Keep charges and product access correct when requests are retried, updates arrive late, or another service fails. - Build metering systems, data pipelines, and APIs that turn large volumes of usage into accurate bills, timely spending information, and records that are easy to trace and verify. - Create reusable building blocks that let product teams launch new offerings, pricing, and payment options without rebuilding the foundations each time. - Make complex financial workflows simple for customers and internal teams, using customer feedback and experiments to improve the experience. - Scale and evolve live systems while protecting customer access, financial accuracy, performance, and security. - Own problems from early design through launch and operation, working with product, design, finance, and other engineering teams to make and test important technical decisions. items.title: Customer Trust Manager F/M
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As a Customer Trust Manager within the Customer Intelligence & Trust department, reporting to the Customer Intelligence & Trust Director, your scope will cover all Betclic markets and products. Your mission will be to build and develop Betclic’s Voice of Customer (VoC) approach to better understand the issues affecting customer experience and trust, and help teams turn these insights into concrete improvements. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 In this role, your main missions will be: Build and run a VoC framework, bringing together feedback from Customer Service, social media, app stores, surveys, complaints and other relevant sources. Use AI, analytics and customer tools to connect these sources, while ensuring data quality and reliable findings. Identify and prioritise customer irritants based on their frequency, severity, affected customers, and impact on experience and trust. Where the evidence allows, distinguish broader market trends from issues specific to Betclic. Analyse situations that may undermine trust and consistency across customer touchpoints. Engage relevant teams to investigate issues, make recommendations and drive corrective actions. Build VoC governance and help foster a customer-centric culture by sharing findings, aligning stakeholders at all levels around common priorities, and establishing continuous improvement routines. Success measures: Key sources of customer feedback are consolidated and used regularly. Priority irritants lead to tracked actions with the relevant teams. VoC findings inform decisions across Customer Ops, Product, Marketing and other relevant teams. VoC actions are tracked with relevant indicators, and their impact is assessed with the teams responsible for implementing them. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm ! This job is for you if: You have experience in Customer Experience, Voice of Customer, continuous improvement or cross-functional project management. You have B2C experience, ideally in digital services, platforms or consumer products. You have a strong customer focus and interest in trust, perceived fairness, communication and brand experience. You have the ability to structure varied feedback, develop clear recommendations and drive implementation across teams without direct authority; experience engaging senior stakeholders (Director, VP or C-level) is a plus. You have a strong interest in AI and analytics tools, with the judgement to assess their outputs and limitations. You have data awareness; experience with Tableau, Power BI, Omni or equivalent tools is a plus. You have excellent synthesis, communication and coordination skills, and professional French & English. WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝 If your application is shortlisted, Elliot will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will meet Audrey, Customer Intelligence & Trust Director, your future manager, followed by Gilles, Head of Customer Intelligence. You will then complete a practical case study to explore how you analyse customer feedback, identify underlying issues and translate your findings into clear, actionable recommendations. Finally, Elliot will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux, remote work possible from another city (on-site presence required) Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX
