items.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role WRITER is looking for a senior lifecycle marketing manager to own how we engage, nurture, and grow our audiences across the customer journey. You'll own our email and lifecycle marketing program end to end, from strategy and audience development through hands-on execution, measurement, and optimization. At the heart of the role is a simple goal: getting the right message to the right person at the right time. This is both a strategic and highly hands-on role. You'll define our lifecycle strategy and then get into HubSpot to build it: creating emails, audiences, workflows, nurture programs, triggered journeys, tests, and reporting. You'll use behavioral, account, intent, and engagement signals to understand where people are in their journey and create experiences that become more relevant and personalized over time. You'll also help define what lifecycle marketing looks like in an AI-first world, exploring how AI can change the way we build audiences, personalize communications, and use email to move people throughout their journey with WRITER. This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, or Seattle hubs. You will report directly into the Director, lifecycle marketing. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do - Own our email and lifecycle marketing program end to end, from strategy and audience development through hands-on execution, measurement, and optimization in HubSpot - Build and manage emails, audiences, workflows, nurture programs, triggered journeys, A/B tests, and reporting directly in HubSpot without relying on marketing operations - Drive audience segmentation strategy, getting into the weeds of how our database is structured to deliver the right message to the right person at the right time across a growing contact base - Use behavioral, account, intent, and engagement signals to create experiences that become more relevant and personalized over time, supporting complex enterprise buying journeys and account-based GTM motions - Partner cross-functionally with demand generation, ABM, content, product marketing, and sales to align lifecycle programs with broader GTM priorities and ensure nurture supports pipeline from first touch through expansion - Explore how AI can transform the way we build audiences, personalize communications, and use email to move people through their journey — experimenting quickly and pushing beyond traditional lifecycle playbooks - Establish the reporting and measurement framework that connects lifecycle activity to engagement, pipeline, and revenue outcomes, and translate performance into clear decisions and program improvements ⭐️ What you need - 6+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, email, or retention marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. - Experience owning an email and lifecycle marketing program end to end, including both strategy and hands-on execution. - Experience building lifecycle programs for complex enterprise buying journeys and understanding how email and nurture support account-based GTM motions. - Deep hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform. You should be comfortable independently building emails, lists, workflows, nurture programs, automation, and reporting. - Experience using person-level and account-level signals to inform segmentation, nurture, personalization, and lifecycle strategy. - Strong understanding of segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and audience management. - Strong understanding of email fundamentals, including deliverability, experimentation, frequency management, QA, and performance measurement. - Strong analytical instincts and the ability to translate performance into clear decisions and program improvements. - A builder mentality. You're equally comfortable developing the strategy and getting into the tools to make it happen. - Strong ownership and comfort operating in ambiguity, identifying what needs to happen rather than waiting for a fully formed brief. - A strong point of view on personalization and curiosity about how AI is changing email, audience strategy, and lifecycle marketing. You don't need to have all the answers, but you should be excited to experiment, learn quickly, and push beyond traditional lifecycle playbooks. 🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees) - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) - Fertility and family planning support - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution - Annual work-life stipends for: - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. - Learning and development stipend - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites - Competitive compensation, company stock options and 401k WRITER is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to diversity. Under the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. items.description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com http://WRITER.com. 📐 About the role You will join a highly motivated, rapidly growing, and hard-working Go-to-Market Enablement team that takes pride in developing our GTM team's skills. Our primary objective is to improve productivity, helping teams accelerate sales cycles and deliver more value for our customers. As the sales enablement director, you will be responsible for crafting and defining our ongoing sales enablement strategy — equipping our Account Executives and Sales Development Representatives with the methodology, skills, and content they need to win. This role will work closely with Sales leadership to identify capability gaps, drive sales methodology adoption, and elevate deal execution across the pipeline. The ideal candidate is strategic, has outstanding project management skills, loves solving sophisticated problems, and is not afraid to launch, test, and iterate in an ever-evolving environment. This is currently an individual contributor role and you will report to the VP, GTM Enablement. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do - Own the global sales enablement strategy for our AE and SDR teams, aligning every program to revenue goals, pipeline coverage, and win-rate improvement — you'll connect the dots between what sellers need and what the business needs to hit its number. - Define and operationalize our sales methodology, shaping how our teams qualify, pursue, and close opportunities — you'll design and deliver ongoing skills training in discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing that builds measurable selling capability across the field. - Drive new hire selling readiness from day one, owning our onboarding curriculum and certification end-to-end — you'll get AEs and SDRs productive faster, cutting ramp time and setting the tone for how they sell from their very first week. - Build an everboarding engine that keeps sellers sharp, measuring selling proficiency across the field and spotting gaps where additional enablement is needed — you'll leverage real-deal insights and call recordings to turn every win and loss into a learning opportunity, tracking program effectiveness and pushing for continuous improvement. - Own the sales content strategy and library, making sure sellers can find and use the right assets at the right moment — you'll leverage WRITER itself to build AI-native workflows that make sellers faster, sharper, and more efficient. - Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, GTM leadership, and RevOps to ensure field-ready messaging, solution-level use-case enablement, and tight feedback loops between the field and the teams that support them — you'll be the connective tissue that keeps everyone aligned and moving in the same direction. ⭐️ What you need - 7+ years experience in enablement, sales leadership, or a relevant role; experience in a customer-facing sales role preferred, but not required. - Proven track record of architecting and executing successful sales enablement programs that deliver measurable impact to organizational growth — win rate, ramp time, quota attainment, and pipeline velocity. - Experience at high-growth startups is a plus. - Demonstrated ability to take broad visions and concepts and develop structured plans, actions, and measurable metrics. - Exceptional ability to build strong cross-functional relationships - Proficient in building & leveraging AI solutions to improve efficiency and effectiveness of sales teams - Strong communication and facilitation skills, with a track record of engaging live and asynchronous enablement delivery. - Strong program management skills — implementing, leading, and measuring enablement initiatives end-to-end. - Creation and delivery of engaging enablement content, including innovative ways to help teams absorb and apply content. 🍩 Benefits & perks (US Full-time employees) - Generous PTO, plus company holidays - Medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family - Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks) - Fertility and family planning support - Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri https://www.galleri.com/partner/writer - Flexible spending account and dependent FSA options - Health savings account for eligible plans with company contribution - Annual work-life stipends for: - Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc. - Learning and development stipend - Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites - Competitive compensation, company stock options and 401k WRITER is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to diversity.
